items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Mother of stainless art and new creation, five-faced Father hidden in splendor: may their yamal-burst Heart, deathless kin beyond all, flash forth; the unplungeable ocean condensed to plain essence — hear it; the heart-lotus uncontracted by the master's feet gathered for worship. [1] Knowledge frees as opponent of bondage-cause ignorance, twofold: doubt-natured and wrong-conviction-natured in the intellect, thought-natured and contracted in the person — root of saṃsāra; initiation washes the personal but needs prior shun-and-take determination, impossible while intellect cannot decide; hence determinative intellect-dwelling knowledge is principal, and practiced kills the personal too, ending in thought-free; only Lord-spoken scripture fully authorizes and fully frees, five streams to sixfold books to inexhaustible Mālinīvijaya. [2] Own-nature alone is adoptable: one autonomous light-consciousness, all-pervading, eternal, form and formless; autonomy is bliss, wonder is will, light is consciousness, grasp is knowing, all-fitness is action; resting in own bliss it is Śiva, contracting itself called atom, re-manifesting with or without means — will, knowing, action, three immersions plus a fourth taught here in order.
